coding.note: Pages 1, 3 and 4 have interleaved two-column text, so quotes there are kept to single-line spans. There are no ARCH or TRAIN novelty claims: the mid-flight LR and clipping changes are described as ad-hoc and are not ablated (the paper notes it was unable to fully ablate them). Comparator scoring is MIXED: GPT-3 scores are taken from its paper, while Davinci was evaluated through the API for the bias/toxicity tests and the MultiRC check. Data is PARTIAL because sources are listed without mixture proportions. Tokens: the corpus has 180B tokens, and the LR schedule runs over 300B tokens.
